title: Supported Postgres extensions updated to new versions
body:
The following supported Postgres extensions are now available at newer versions. Existing installations keep their current version until you update them with `ALTER EXTENSION`.

* `postgis`, `postgis_raster`, `postgis_sfcgal`, `postgis_tiger_geocoder`, `postgis_topology`, `address_standardizer`, and `address_standardizer_data_us`: updated to 3.3.10 on Postgres 16, 3.5.7 on Postgres 17, and 3.6.4 on Postgres 18.
* `hll`: updated to 2.21 on Postgres 16, 17, and 18.

See [Update an extension version](/aws/en/oltp/projects/extensions#update-an-extension-version).
